intro: ITrackZen is the GPS tracking and fleet management brand of LibDex Ltd, a logistics and technology company. This website presents our services and helps businesses ask for a quote or discuss a partnership. The tracking software itself is the ITrackZen platform at itrackzen.com.
mission: Our mission is to make professional fleet visibility accessible to businesses across Africa and around the world, so that every vehicle on the road is safer, more efficient and more accountable.

pillars.title: Tracking
pillars.text: Live location, route history, geofencing and alerts for vehicles, assets and people.

pillars.title: Video telematics
pillars.text: AI dashcams that add visual evidence and driver-safety coaching to GPS data.

pillars.title: Fleet intelligence
pillars.text: Reports and dashboards that turn movement, fuel and driver data into decisions.

values.title: Reliability
values.text: Fleets run around the clock, so our platform and support are built to be dependable.

values.title: Privacy and security
values.text: Customer data stays under customer control, protected by encryption and access roles.

values.title: Local understanding
values.text: We design for long corridors, remote areas and mixed network coverage found across Africa.

values.title: Honest partnership
values.text: Clear advice, transparent quotes and hardware recommendations that fit your real needs.

why: Support for many GPS tracker brands and protocols, so you are not tied to one device vendor
One platform for GPS tracking, sensors, driver ID and AI video, where your hardware supports them
Web and mobile access to your fleet
Plans for single vehicles, mixed fleets and multi-country operations
Honest advice on which hardware fits your vehicles
Flexible cooperation for resellers, installers and corporate fleets
regions_text: Our focus markets are Somalia, Kenya, Uganda, Ethiopia, South Sudan and DR Congo, and we serve other countries where we can support the customer's hardware, connectivity and installation needs. We confirm availability case by case.
